method: Headless Chromium, default IndexedDB persistence, backend fetch blocked before awaited mutation; next asynchronous controller action closes page without client.close, queue inspection or server read before closure; new page opens stored device with null backend and finds one queued mutation; reconnect settles it once. No keepalive/write-through path.
limits: One reduced awaited-admission case, not full Muse settings app, arbitrary pre-admission tab destruction, process crash, or power-loss proof. Controller handoff after evaluate is not a zero-nanosecond kill.
